integrity: Exact symbolic derivation supplemented by independent truncated spherical-harmonic expansion; finite checks are not the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Real harmonic unit balls, dimension d>=3, one fixed radial weight; no general radial-weight or holomorphic kernel result; full text of relevant 2008 weighted-kernel paper inaccessible for historical-priority check.
title: Sharp zero-free radius and complete angular nodal classification for linearly weighted harmonic Bergman kernels of real balls
